title: @tspace
description: a space under @tspace: its seed, its strategy, and at most one backing; the body is expanded first, and an empty body is the default space's shape

seed.description: tuples written by the create that makes the space; a space that already exists keeps its own

items.description: a tuple: an ordered list of json values, its first the tuple's type

reflexes.description: exclusive: a reflex is the only destination of the tuples it matches, and an overlapping one is refused; shared: every matching reflex is called, in the order declared

run.description: the backing: in memory, in the host process

owned.description: the backing: a file the space is, held by this process alone

shared.description: the backing: a file the space is, owners on one host taking turns
